title: Position: Beyond Assistance – Reimagining LLMs as Ethical and Adaptive Co-Creators in Mental Health Care
findings: The paper does not present its own findings on religion but cites recent work (Babonnaud et al., 2024) that revealed both explicit and subtle religious biases in LLM outputs, particularly in descriptions of minority groups. This is used to emphasize the need for robust, human-centered evaluation frameworks to address such biases.
